## Objective

Protect concurrent work and publish only exact revalidated outcomes.

## Scope

- Canonical coordination
- Isolated candidates
- Manual operations and recovery

## Entry conditions

- Current scope is selected and predecessor active work is reconciled.

## Exit criteria

- Dirty work and uncertain actors are preserved through integration, pause and retry.

## Risks

- Cross-subsystem writes retain real partial boundaries.

### Risks

- Local locks cannot establish ownership across unsupported clones.

### Acceptance criteria

- Overlapping, paused and uncertain Director/Curator owners block or route through their current owner.
- Dirty/staged/unrelated edits survive; unsupported multi-clone/local-remote ownership is held.

### Planned verification

- Test concurrent worktrees, registry/path aliases, active/uncertain owners and dirty index preservation.
- Verify no automatic stash, reset, clean or competing ledger.

- Inject target/source changes between review and integration and prove stale candidate rejection.
- Validate integrated output again with affected owner checks.

## TASK-021 - Implement pause and exact partial recovery

Retain ordinary pause, retry and exact partial-operation recovery.

| --- | --- |
| Status | `completed` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-008, REQ-017, REQ-023, REQ-027, REQ-038 |

| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | 2026-09-12T22:12:14.483595Z |

### Risks

- Do not delete receipts or roll back later user work to make recovery pass.

### Acceptance criteria

- Retries use original operation identity and exact pre/post bytes; partial publication and later human edits remain visible.
- Ordinary pause closes new work while preserving pending state. Retry retains the original operation and recorded partial results.

### Planned verification

- Fault-inject each integration/publication boundary and test uncertain interrupt, timeout, restart and current-owner recovery.
- Confirm timestamps alone never prove stopping or permit takeover.

### Risks

- Command discovery or a conversational phrase cannot silently activate a new execution.

### Acceptance criteria

- Status does not run model analysis or repair; explicit review does only bounded requested analysis without canonical writes.
- Manual mutations and exact retries use the same authorization and publication gates as automatic operations.

### Planned verification

- Compare before/after file inventories and tool-call counters for read-only routes.
- Run manual/automatic equivalence and exact correction selection tests.
